description: Native type=object form buttons on workflow-adopted models that no contract profile declares. The adopted model set is the evaluated PROFILE_BY_MODEL registry, so helper-built profiles count too. Each entry records the nature of the button so the uncovered set is explicit; it grants no meaning and does not replace a declared purpose.
registry_rule: A native object button on an adopted model must either be declared by a contract profile or be listed here. Entries go stale when the method becomes declared or disappears from the views.

classes.state_transition_undeclared: the button changes record state; the missing declaration is an authority-side gap
classes.navigation: opens a related record or view; no state change
classes.document_helper: generates/loads/creates business content; no state change
